notes.title: Cruising Yacht - S/V UMA
notes.content: [h1]🆕 New Boat Added – S/V Uma (Cruising Yacht)[/h1][p][/p][p]Step aboard the legendary [b]S/V Uma[/b], now available in [b]MarineVerse Sailing Club[/b]!  [/p][p]Created in collaboration with Dan & Kika from [b]Sailing Uma[/b], this iconic cruising yacht is ready for your next VR adventure.[/p][p][b]⛵ Why you’ll love it:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Realistic cockpit layout and sailing mechanics  [/p][/*][*][p]Designed with input from real liveaboard sailors  [/p][/*][*][p]Perfect for relaxed cruising or global voyages in the [b]Globe Beta[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]🎯 [b]How to sail Uma:[/b][/p][p]Go to `Main Menu → Free Sail → Cruising Yacht[/p][p]This is your chance to explore what long-distance cruising feels like — no ocean required.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="AQyy_nQzWBg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p]

notes.title: Mac & Windows PC Support for MarineVerse Cup
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=RFdwMJfC6MM;full][/previewyoutube]

No VR? No worries! Our latest update brings the thrilling experience of virtual sailing to your flat screen. 

Whether you’re analyzing your tactics in replay mode or taking the helm for the first time, MarineVerse Cup on PC is your new portal to the seas. 

Download now and join the world’s largest virtual sailing club!

🖥️ Experience MarineVerse Cup on PC:

- Spectate races with a tactical view
- Learn the basics without a VR headset

See full guide here:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1835729726

Happy sailing!
